answer_1.quote: We conducted experiments on three mainstream LLM tasks: instructionfollowing, mathematical reasoning, and codegenerating.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses for instruction-following prompts, mathematical problem solutions, and code snippets.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy (acc) is used as the evaluation metric for all other tasks. We employ AlpacaEval to evaluate models fine-tuned on Stanford Alpaca dataset, using win-rate as the evaluation metric and GPT-4 as the annotator. For HumanEval we use pass@1 as the evaluation metric.
